jobs.title: The Ultimate Guide to HAZOP, LOPA, and FMEA for Engineers
jobs.description: HAZOP (Hazards and Operability Study) is a structured and systematic examination of a complex planned or existing process. It is arguably the most essential qualitative risk assessment technique in the process industry today. Unlike general brainstorming, HAZOP is rigorous.
